The uniqueness of Habib University’s Scholarship and Financial Aid Program is in its ability to meet the needs of our admitted students and offer individualized scholarships and financial aid packages as per their merit, need, and circumstances. Habib University acknowledges the effort of all hard-working students through providing financial support and student loans to deserving students in order to meet their demonstrated financial needs. Choosing Habib University for your undergraduate degree program is a worthwhile investment for your future. Talented and hard-working students with a passion to learn can easily afford to study at Habib University and benefit from its unmatched scholarship and financial aid program. Student Finance Guidebook Payment guidelines Scholarships Financial Aid To ensure equal opportunities for all prospective students irrespective of their religious, ethnic, racial, gender or socio-economic background, Habib University offers unmatched scholarships to students, to acknowledge their achievements thus far, so that they can pursue their four-year degree program at the University. Based on the candidate’s admission score, they may receive one of our renewable scholarships in recognition of their strong academic achievements. Entrance scholarships are granted between 20% & 100%, depending on your merit score. For International Examination Board Applicants, Habib University offers three these types of Scholarships Habib YOHSIN Scholarship These are 100% scholarships available, on tuition & laboratory and/or studio fees, for exceptionally well-rounded and highly meritorious students. At Habib University, being a distinguished YOHSIN scholar is the highest honor for incoming students. Habib Excellence Scholarship These undergraduate scholarships cover 60% to 80% of tuition & laboratory and/or studio fees of the recipients. Habib Merit Scholarship These scholarships cover up to 50% of tuition & laboratory and/or studio fees of the recipients. For National Examination Board Applicants, Habib University offers these types of Scholarships: Habib University’s Talent, Opportunity, Promotion and Support (HUTOPS) Students with HU TOPS scholarship are awarded 100% financial support for the duration of the four-year undergraduate program of their choice at Habib University. Habib University Equal Opportunity Program Scholarship (HUEOPS) Students with HU EOP scholarship can be awarded up to 80% financial support. How are Scholarships Determined? The Scholarships awarded by Habib University at the time of admissions are not determined just on the basis of High School Grades. Key factors that contribute in determining the eligibility of students for the Scholarship include the following: Grades obtained in secondary/higher secondary schools Performance in Habib University’s Entrance Examination/SAT Scores Communication skills including writing Interview scores Meta-curricular scores Maintaining the Required CGPA All undergraduate scholarships for Pakistani students are automatically renewed each semester up to a total of four years of study, however in order to maintain or continue receiving the Scholarship students must make sure that the provided the conditions listed below are met: The student stays enrolled as a full-time student unless the university has approved part-time enrollment. The student maintains a minimum cumulative GPA (CGPA): 3.5 for the YOHISN scholarship 3.0 for the Habib Excellence Scholarship 2.75 for the Habib Merit Scholarships 3.0 for the HU TOPS Scholarship 3.0 for the HU EOP Scholarship The student is in good conduct standing and has not violated any conduct policy. We trust the capabilities of all our students and realize that they can meet their academic endeavors in a variety of ways. Habib University’s Office of Academic Performance, Writing Centre and EHSAS Centre provide remedial support to students in overcoming their academic problems. Academic Advisors provide one-on-one guidance to students in different areas. In case students are unable to maintain the required CGPA, their scholarships will not be withdrawn immediately. They will be provided a probationary semester to improve their performance and achieve the required CGPA. How To Apply? Candidates who wish to apply for a Scholarship can access the scholarship application by logging into their e-application . Award of Scholarship for Admitted/Existing Students These Scholarships, if eligible, are only awarded at the time of Admission and cannot be awarded after an applicant has accepted admission. However, during the course of studies, students may become eligible for semester-based scholarships based on academic performance, specifically, the High Academic Achievement Scholarship and the High Academic Leap Scholarship. Each of these scholarships is equivalent upto 10% of the tuition fee for the applicable semester, where applicable. * While scholarship opportunities in Round 2 are limited, financial support remains available. Students are encouraged to apply for financial aid. Habib University’s financial Aid program offers generous grants and facilitation to acquire student loans. The Financial Aid Program Which aims to ensure equal opportunities for all. In addition to applying for scholarships, students may simultaneously apply for financial aid. The amount of financial aid awarded depends on the needs of the students. Habib University offers a personalized financial aid plan to each admitted student as per their specific needs and the overall circumstances. This Financial Aid Program is available for the International Examination Boards, for the students from the Boards of Intermediate Education (BIE), Federal Board (FB) and Aga Khan University Examination Board (AKU-EB) the financial support is provided by our HU TOPS and HU EOP Programs. Grants These Grants are awarded based on the financial need assessed through the financial aid application at the time of admission. Grants are subject to an annual review of a student’s financial circumstances and do not need to be repaid. A grant is not a loan. Maintaining the Required CGPA Financial Aid is automatically renewed each semester up to a total of four years of study, however in order to maintain or continue receiving the Financial Aid students must make sure that the conditions listed below are met: Enrollment as a full-time student, unless the University has approved part-time enrollment Maintaining a minimum CGPA of 2.33 every semester Maintaining good conduct standing and following the University’s established code of conduct Grant of Financial Aid for Admitted/Existing Students In case a student or their parent/guardian experiences a significant change in their financial circumstances that adversely affects their ability to pay the University fees, the student may contact Office of Student Finance and apply for an Annual Financial Aid Review. Facilitation for Student Loans in Pakistan As part of our financial aid program, the students & their families can also opt to be financially assisted through student loans. The loans will be governed by the rules and regulations of the institution offering the student loan in Pakistan. Details are shared with the student and parents while finalizing their fee package at the time of admission. How To Apply for Student Loan? Candidates who wish to apply for Financial Aid can get access to the scholarship application by logging into their e-application . Student Employment While not a formal part of a student’s financial aid package, the Student Employment Portal – Habib University allows students to earn while they learn by working on campus for an agreed period and receiving an hourly wage. This program offers students a valuable professional learning experience, helping them: Build time management and work ethics Enhance technical and interpersonal skills Gain exposure to real workplace dynamics Employment opportunities include roles such as Teaching Assistant, Peer Tutor, Library Assistant, Research or Administrative Support, and assisting departments like MARCOM, Admissions, and others. Students become eligible from Semester II, provided they maintain satisfactory academic performance — a minimum CGPA of 2.33 for regular positions and 3.0 for Teaching Assistant or Peer Tutor roles. Admissions for Fall 2026 are now open. For International board admissions schedule, visit: International Admission Schedule For national board admissions schedule, visit: National Admission Schedule Before applying, review eligibility for your program: International board: Admission Prerequisites National board: Admission Criteria Apply online: eapplication.habib.edu.pk What are the general admissions criteria? The eligibility criteria for International Examination Board applicants can be found on the following link: https://habib.edu.pk/admissions/international-examination-board/admission-prerequisites/ The eligibility criteria for National Examination Board applicants can be found on the following link: https://habib.edu.pk/admissions/national-examination-boards/ What does the admissions process entail? For International Examination Board Applicants the application process can be found on the following link: https://habib.edu.pk/admissions/international-examination-board/how-to-apply/ For National Examination Board Applicants the application process can be found on the following link: https://habib.edu.pk/admissions/national-examination-boards/ How do I proceed with my online application? Once you have registered for an account with Habib University, you will be assigned an Applicant ID number (username, your email address) and password. Be sure you save these details as the system will allow you to complete parts of your application, save your information, and return to your application at your convenience. What documents do I need to attach to my application You need to attach the following documents with your e-application section of the ‘Upload Documents’: Original document or Attested copies of original Secondary and Higher Secondary School Certificates/Diploma as per your examination board. Attested Secondary and Higher Secondary School Transcripts/Mark Sheets as per your examination board. You also need to bring original copies for verification. Your CNIC/Passport What should I include in my Meta-Curricular Experience Form? Your meta-curricular experience represents the activities you participated in, outside the classroom and the skills you gained. Meta-curricular experience may include the following: Participation and learning from Co-curricular activities such as debates, dramas, sports, MUNs, singing, dancing, painting, writing etc. Participation and learning from Community Service or Voluntary work such as initiatives taken to help people and communities around you, find ways to better the environment, raise awareness of important issues and other activities which may support your community and society. Participation and learning from Work experience such as internships, part-time jobs, private tutoring, running your own organization/project or any other freelance work. What is a Portfolio? A portfolio is a collection of works that you assemble in order to demonstrate that you have the appropriate prior skills and/or showcase your learning in or out of the classroom. It is the creative expression of you and your work up until the time of submission. A portfolio could be a collection of your poems, articles, drawings etc. It could be videos you have developed, photographs you have taken or any other creative product you have designed. If I don’t submit a portfolio, will it have a negative impact on my application? The portfolio will add value to an application, but it is not a requirement. Applicants who do not submit a portfolio will not be disfavored in the admissions process in any way. What should be included in my portfolio? Habib University asks that you submit samples of creative and/or intellectual work that you have produced up until now. Remember: quality, not quantity. If your work received wider recognition that was beyond your high school, we’d love to see it! What is to be submitted, however, relies mostly on what your intended school or program is. Examples include, but are certainly not limited to, an article published in a newspaper; a research paper; a photo or video of a science project; a poem or song that you have written and/or performed; samples of code that you have had significant influence in writing; and photographs or creative designs. How can I pay the application fee? Please visit the following webpage link that outlines the ways you can use to pay the application fee: https://habib.edu.pk/admissions/student-finance/epayment-guidelines/ I entered an incorrect ID Number In case the information in your e-application needs to be corrected/altered (example: your mailing address or phone number), you can contact the Office of Admissions at admissions@habib.edu.pk and put in a request. Will I receive a confirmation after submitting my e-application? Yes, you will receive a text message and message of submission appears in the lower half portion of the ‘Review & Submit’ section of the e-application. Does Habib University help me prepare for its Entrance Examination? Yes, our admissions team provides a comprehensive guide for Entrance Exams. We also offer preparatory sessions to help students get ready for the test. To learn more, email us at admissions@habib.edu.pk . What are the assessment criteria for admissions? The application screening procedure at Habib University is individualized and holistic in nature. Our admissions criteria are based on a number of factors, including: Academic potential (transcripts, board exam results, entrance test and academic achievements) Intellectual, creative and personal pursuits and passions (co-curricular/extra-curricular involvement and interests) Writing competencies Admissions interview Will I be required to appear for an interview as part of the admissions process? Yes, an interview is a key part of our holistic admissions process. Unfortunately, we cannot interview all of our applicants. After the Entrance Examination, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and informed of the date, time and location of their interview. What should I expect at my interview? The interview is an opportunity for you to demonstrate your potential in a multi-dimensional way. Our interview sessions are more like discussions with applicants about their interests, experiences and the thoughts they express in their essays. What is the duration of Habib University’s Undergraduate degree program? All undergraduate programs in Pakistan at Habib University are four-year programs. I am already enrolled in another university and want to transfer to HU – am I eligible and will my credits transfer? Habib University takes transfer students. For more details, please visit ‘ Transferred Students ’. What is the fee structure? Visit our Tuition Fees page for a detailed fee structure. Are there any Scholarships or Financial Assistance/Aid available at Habib University? At Habib University , we offer generous scholarships and financial aid. For more information, visit our Scholarship and Financial Aid page . Can I apply through a paper application? No, we only accept online applications. You can complete your e-application at habib.edu.pk . When will I receive my admission decision? Admission decisions are made on a rolling basis, which means that as and when an applicant’s admissions are evaluated as they are submitted, results are communicated to applicants through their e-application portal and via email throughout the process. Whom should I contact if I need any information related to admissions? You can contact us through any of the following means if you require any help or information: Visit the Office of Admissions Habib University Block 18, Gulistan-e-Jauhar University Avenue, Off Shahrah-e-Faisal Karachi, Pakistan Call Us: +92 21 111 042242 (HABIB) Ext. 4571, 5132,4520 Talk to our Counselors: +92 321 820 3568 | +92 321 820 3545 Email Us: admissions@habib.edu.pk Web: www.habib.edu.pk Follow us on Facebook , Twitter and Instagram to get regular updates about our events and admission related information. Scholarships Who can apply for Habib University’s scholarships? All students eligible for admission at Habib University can apply for its scholarships. When should I apply for a scholarship? All students may apply for scholarships at the time of submitting their admission application. The scholarship form is accessible through the e-application portal and must be completed and submitted before the admission application deadline. How can I apply for a scholarship? The process to apply for scholarship is easy and simple. Follow the steps mentioned below: Step 1. Gather details about the scholarships here . Step 2. Gain access to the online scholarship application by logging into your e-application . Step 3. Fill in and submit the online scholarship form. What type of scholarships are offered by Habib University? For International Examination Board Applicants, Habib University offers three types of scholarships HABIB YOHSIN SCHOLARSHIP These are 100% Scholarships available, on tuition & laboratory and/or studio fees, for exceptionally well-rounded and highly meritorious students. At Habib University, being a distinguished YOHSIN scholar is the highest honor for incoming students. HABIB EXCELLENCE SCHOLARSHIP These Scholarships cover 60% to 80% of tuition & laboratory and/or studio fees of the recipients. HABIB MERIT SCHOLARSHIP These Scholarships cover up to approximately 50% of tuition & laboratory and/or studio fees of the recipients. For National Examination Board Applicants, Habib University offers the types of scholarships: HABIB UNIVERSITY’S TALENT, OPPORTUNITY, PROMOTION AND SUPPORT (HUTOPS) Students with HU TOPS Scholarship are awarded 100% financial support for the duration of the four-year undergraduate program of their choice at Habib University. HABIB UNIVERSITY EQUAL OPPORTUNITY PROGRAM SCHOLARSHIP (HUEOPS) Students will HU EOP Scholarship can be awarded up to 80% financial support. Do I also need to fill in the Financial Aid Application, if I am applying for a Scholarship? Yes you may apply to both Scholarships and Financial Aid. Eligibility varies by merit, financial need, and individual circumstances. What documents do I need to submit? All required documents are listed on the Scholarship Form that can be accessed via the e-application. What are the criteria for awarding Scholarships? The Scholarships awarded by Habib University at the time of Admissions are not determined just on the basis of High School Grades. Key factors that contribute in determining the eligibility of students for the Scholarship include the following: Grades obtained in secondary/higher secondary schools Performance in Habib University’s Entrance Examination Communication skills including writing Interview scores Meta-curricular scores When and how will I know if I have been awarded a Scholarship? The Scholarship decision (if applied for) will be communicated to you after you have secured Admissions at the University. Are Scholarship decisions negotiable? Scholarship decisions are non-negotiable. Are Scholarships awarded for four years or one year? Scholarships awarded at the time of admission are for four years, provided the recipient fulfills the following conditions: Being enrolled as a full-time student, unless the University has approved part-time enrollment Maintaining a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.5 for YOHSIN Scholarship, CGPA of 3.0 for Habib Excellence Scholarship, HUTOPS and HUEOPS, and 2.75 for Habib Merit Scholarship. Actively participating in meta-curricular activities beyond the classroom Being on Good academic Academic Standing and follow the University’s policies and procedures. Being on Good Conduct Standing How will the University support me if I am struggling to maintain the CGPA required to continue with the Scholarship and/or Financial Aid? We trust the capabilities of all our Students and facilitate them in their academic Academic endeavors through a variety of ways. Habib University’s Office of Academic Performance, Writing Centre and EHSAS Centre provide remedial support to students in overcoming their academic problems. Faculty Academic Advisors provide one-on-one guidance to students in different areas. In case students are not able to maintain the required CGPA, their Scholarship and/or Financial Aid will not be withdrawn immediately. They will be provided a probationary semester to improve their performance and achieve the required CGPA. Will my Scholarship be reviewed each semester? Scholarships awarded at the time of Admission are not reviewed every year. They are renewed each year Semester against your Academic performance at the University. Depending on your performance, it may change accordingly. If you maintain the required CGPA, your Scholarship will automatically be renewed after every semester. Financial Aid What is Financial Aid? Our Financial Aid Program supports the students enrolled at Habib University to meet tuition and other fee requirements of the University. Under its Financial Aid Program, the University offers Grants after evaluating their individual’s needs and circumstances. Who can apply for Habib University’s Financial Aid? All students who apply for admission at Habib University are eligible to apply for Financial Aid if they can demonstrate genuine financial need hindering their ability to fulfill their University tuition expenses. When should I apply for Financial Aid? All students may apply for financial aid at the time of submitting their admission application. The financial aid form is accessible through the e-application portal and must be completed and submitted before the admission application deadline. How can I apply for Financial Aid? For New applicants, applying for Financial Aid is a simple and easy process. Follow the steps mentioned below: Step 1. Gather details about the Financial Aid here . Step 2. Gain access to the online Financial Aid application by logging into your e-application. Step 3. Fill in and submit the online Financial Aid Form. If I have not applied for Financial Aid at the time of Admission, can I apply for it during the course of my study at Habib University? If during your Habib journey you wish to apply for Financial Aid due to change in the financial circumstances, you have the opportunity to apply for an increase in Financial Aid annually, at the start of academic year. Your application will be reviewed as per Habib University’s policy and decisions will be taken accordingly. You may contact the Office of Student Finance in this regard. Do I also need to fill in a Scholarship form if I am applying for Financial Aid? Yes you may apply to both Scholarships and Financial Aid. Eligibility varies by merit, financial need, and individual circumstances. What documents do I need to submit? You need to submit several documents along with your application for a fair assessment of your application. All documents that need to be attached with the online Financial Aid form are listed on the online Financial Aid form. What if my parents are unwilling to disclose information on the Financial Aid form? For a fair assessment of your application, it is essential that you provide complete information in your application. Incomplete applications will not be evaluated. All financial information and documents submitted to the Office of Student Finance Office will be are treated as confidential. What can I expect during the verification stage of my Application? While evaluating student applications, the Office of Student Finance may conduct verification from a recognized source or third party to ensure that the information submitted is genuine. They may also request additional documents or explanation of information from the student. Failing to provide information, giving incomplete or incorrect information, or concealing of information will result in the withdrawal or denial of Financial Aid. The University also reserves the right to take strict disciplinary action against such applicants or students. When and how will I know if I have been granted a Financial Aid package? The Financial Aid decision (if you have applied for) will be communicated to you after you have secured admissions at the University. Are Financial Aid decisions negotiable? Generally, Financial Aid decisions are non-negotiable. Will the Financial Aid awarded at the time of Admissions be continued for the complete four-year undergraduate program? Financial Aid awarded at the time of admission will continue for the four-year period if the following conditions are met: Being enrolled as a full-time Student, unless the University has approved part-time enrolment Maintaining a minimum Cumulative GPA of 2.33 Being on good conduct standing and following University’s Code of Conduct. The financial situation of the family as assessed at the time of Admissions remains the same. How will the University support me if I struggle in maintaining the CGPA required to continue the Financial Aid program? We trust the capabilities of all our Students and facilitate them in their academic endeavors through a variety of ways. Habib University’s Office of Academic Performance, Writing Centre and EHSAS Centre provide remedial support to students in overcoming their academic problems. Academic Advisors provide one-on-one guidance to Students in different areas. In case students are not able to maintain the required CGPA, their financial Financial aid Aid will not be withdrawn immediately. They will be provided a probationary semester to improve their performance and achieve the required CGPA. Will my Financial Aid be reviewed every year? Yes, your Financial Aid will be reviewed at the start of Academic Year. You will be required to submit the Financial Aid Form, with updated records, every year If your financial situation remains as it was declared at the time of Admission or last review, Financial Aid will continue without any change. Habib University’s Deferred Fee Plan and Grants Does Habib University offer grants? Yes, Habib University does offer grants to students based on their financial condition and the University’s criteria. How can I apply for grants? You only need to apply for Financial Aid. There is no need to submit a separate application for grants. Is there any maximum or minimum range for the amount of grants awarded? The amount of grants awarded depends on your demonstrated financial need. Student Employment at Habib University What is the Student Employment option? Under the Student Employment Program, students can work up to 16 hours per week during the semester and 40 hours per week during summer or winter breaks. Students are paid hourly for their work and can apply from Semester II, provided they maintain at least a 2.33 CGPA.For Teaching Assistant and Peer Tutor roles, a minimum 3.0 CGPA is required. What type of work will I be doing? Students are placed in roles based on their interests, skills, and availability. Opportunities may include: Assisting with research projects or maintaining departmental data Supporting internships and Opportunity with MARCOM Working in the Library, laboratories, or other academic and administrative departments Serving as a Peer Tutor, Teaching Assistant, or Student Ambassador All employment is on-campus and supervised by relevant departments. Can I work during semester breaks? Yes, students may continue to work on campus during semester breaks based on need, interest, and availability. How will I be selected? The Office of Student Support and Analytics (OSSA) manages all hiring under this program. Students apply for open positions and are assessed based on required skills and suitability for the role. If I don’t receive Financial Aid, can I still apply? Yes, all eligible students may apply for available opportunities. Selection is based on departmental priorities and assessment outcomes. Will this affect my studies? Student work hours are designed to avoid clashes with classes. With good time management, students can successfully balance both academics and work responsibilities. pages.content: BS Computer Science Overview PLO Curriculum Faculty and Fellows Experiential Learning Future Prospects Success Stories Overview Of The Program Habib University's BS Computer Science degree program is recognized and accredited by the National Computing Education Accreditation Council. Our BSCS program is designed to help you to gain proficiency in a variety of fields, such as Artificial Intelligence, Computer Graphics, Computer Networking, Computer Science Theory, Information Security, Machine Learning, Robotics, and Software Design & Engineering. PROGRAM LEARNING OUTCOMES Students who graduate with a degree in Computer Science will be able to: Theoretical Computer Science: recall and apply foundational principles of computer science. Application Development: build software systems of varying complexity in light of fundamental computer science principles and any other constraints. Analysis and Design: perform technical analysis and design using core computing and mathematical knowledge. Systems: apply the knowledge of computing systems. Research and Exploration: develop expertise in and contribute to a given sub-field of computing by drawing upon a strong foundation in the fundamentals of computer science and mathematics to solve real life problems. Problem Solving: identify and analyze problems and propose effective computing-based solutions. Practical Exposure: make effective use of current tools, technologies, and good industry practices. Responsible Citizenship: conduct their computing practice in a manner that is ethical and socially responsible and corresponds to their distinct sense of identity and service to the community. Self-Learning: continuously adapt their skills to the changes taking place around them. Design Thinking: apply design thinking principles to the design of a solution. Multi-disciplinarity: incorporate knowledge and input from multiple disciplines. Communication and Teamwork: communicate and function effectively as a member or a leader of a variety of teams. 4 year Academic Journey Explore Minors Learn about the Liberal Core Curriculum Details Bachelors of Computer Science major students are required to complete a minimum of 40 courses and 130 credit-hours over their four-year journey (8 semesters), maintaining a minimum CGPA of 2.33. CS Streams The outlined streams are structured to acquaint students with various transdisciplinary approaches within the field of Computer Science. They aim to prompt contemplation of the methods, objectives, and styles of inquiry employed in each specialized area. Artificial Intelligence CS 316 - Introduction to Deep Learning CS 335 - Introduction to Large Language Models CS 451 - Computational Intelligence Social Computing CS 262 - Computational Social Science CS 361 - Social Network Analysis CS 343 - Graph Data Science Programming Languages CS 324 - Advanced Java Programming CS 334 - Competitive Programming CS 370 - Web and Mobile Development Our Faculty and Fellows Rooted in the commitment to teaching excellence, our faculty of computer science degree in Pakistan synergizes with the University's dedication to fostering a collaborative interdisciplinary undergraduate experience, creating a vibrant atmosphere for faculty-student engagement. View All Abdul Samad, Ph.D. Associate Professor, Computer Science Bilal Wajid, Ph.D. Assistant Professor, Computer Science Ayesha Enayat, Ph.D. Assistant Professor, Computer Science Unaiza Ahsan, Ph.D. Assistant Professor, Computer Science View All Experiential Learning At the heart of the Computer Science bachelors program lies experiential learning, merging theoretical knowledge with real-world applications. In addition to learning the latest programing languages, our students actively participate in professional work, research, and service globally, particularly in the South Asian context. This transformative approach enables students to turn ideas into practical impact, paving the way for successful careers and making Habib the best university for computer science in Pakistan. Future Prospects Habib University's Bachelors of Computer Science degree in Pakistan cultivates a unique mindset, imparting versatile skills in mathematics and computer science. Our BSCS degree program equips students with critical thinking and collaboration, emphasizing a hands-on approach to learning that ensures ongoing skill development. This interdisciplinary journey offers growth opportunities, including minors , workshops, and tailored career/grad school programs. Careers Entrepreneurship Graduate School Success The interdisciplinary skill set prepares you for a broad spectrum of professions such as artificial intelligence, computer graphics, computer networking, computer science theory, information security, machine learning, robotics, software design and engineering, and many more. Industries Companies Learn how your individual perspectives from the BS Computer Science program can play a key role in addressing tangible problems through creative, innovative, sustainable, and impactful ventures. Industries Companies Through its interdisciplinary framework, the BSCS degree program cultivates critical thinking and a comprehensive understanding of global dynamics, uniquely positioning our graduates for successful admissions to prestigious institutions worldwide. Industries Companies Success Stories Explore the rich insights about the success of our current BS Computer Science program students and graduates across various fields: Meri Uraan: Inspiring Story of Swaleha Muhammad Saleem (CS ‘22) Furqan Karim, BSCS ’20, a Fintech Entrepreneur Tasbiha Joins Erasmus Mundus Joint Master’s Program in SE4GD Niha Momin | BS Computer Science | HU Stars - Class of 2022 FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS What is Computer Science study for? Computer Science is the study of computers and computational systems. The BS Computer Science program helps students develop an unparalleled understanding of the role technology plays in our society through a distinct curricular framework focusing on Algorithmic Problem Solving, Data Structures, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Web and Mobile App Development, among others. What are the main areas of study for the Computer Science program? BS Computer Science program at Habib University focuses on the following streams: Programming Languages Artificial Intelligence Social Computing What is the eligibility criteria for Bachelor's of Computer Science (BSCS)? To apply for BS Degree in Computer Science, you must have: O Levels: 8 principal subjects (not including Additional Mathematics and General Paper) - Average grade B A Levels: 3 principal subjects, i.e., any 2 science subjects and Mathematics - Average grade C SSC/Matriculation: At least 70% or above overall HSSC/Intermediate: With Mathematics as a compulsory subject and an overall score of 70% or above What is Khidmat (Field Practicum) and its benefits? Khidmat, also known as Field Practicum, is an obligatory aspect of the curriculum for BS Computer Science program students, involving practical fieldwork in social settings. It offers students the opportunity to apply their acquired skills, gain real-world insights, and enhance the relevance of their degree. What is Kaavish? Kaavish is a mandatory senior capstone project designed to provide our students with practical, hands-on experience in tackling real-world challenges. Within a secure environment, students can experiment and come up with innovative solutions by applying computer science theories and systems, while adhering to proper research and problem analysis methodologies. What is the job of Computer Science graduates? Habib University, known among the best universities for computer science in Pakistan, ensures that all students have a seamless transition from the classroom to the outside world. Our alumni are either successfully employed, pursuing graduate studies, or working on their start-ups. Potential career pathways include: Web & App Development Software Development Computer Programming Data Analytics Game Development Blockchain Development Database Administration Information Systems Management Entrepreneurship Graduate School Require more details? Improving access to education being a cornerstone of the Habib University’s mission, the University offers admissions to numerous freshmen every year who cross borders to enter the doors of our campus, and benefit from unlimited opportunities in Pakistan’s most bustling metropolis. Why Karachi? A diverse urban center housing more than 20 million people, Karachi is the financial and social hub of Pakistan. As a focal point of technological and entrepreneurial innovation, it is the city where dreamers come to chase their dreams, capitalizing on the vast array of opportunities available to them. This sprawling port city is also home to a population of migrants from a myriad of backgrounds, all combined in a melting pot to make Karachi one of the most diverse cities in the world. With its world-class cuisine, beaches and local attractions, it has earned a reputation as one of the liveliest cities in Pakistan, or as it is popularly known, “the city of lights.” Habib University is a microcosm of this blend of cultures – our lions are not only encouraged to excel academically but are also taught to listen to differing opinions; to explore ideas that conflict with their own, all the while respecting the tremendous diversity that makes this city quintessentially Karachi. Habib University captures within its walls the spirit of celebration, friendship, tolerance, entrepreneurship, curiosity, and risk-taking that is Karachi. It opens doors for you in the financial, industrial, and non-profit sectors. Explore Habib University – a campus defined by the sparkling energy of the living and breathing city outside its gates. Accommodation for Out of Karachi Students Habib University is cognizant of the fact that outstation students who have been offered admission may require accommodation in Karachi. Being a non-residential campus, Habib University strongly encourages all outstation students to make arrangements for their accommodation well in advance to avoid any inconvenience during studies. Our current students fromoutside of Karachi either stay with their relatives or have acquired a place in the hostels available in Karachi. Some have rented out apartments (in groups of 4-6) on a cost-sharing basis. You may look into areas closer to the university, such as Gulistan-e-Jauhar, Gulshan-e-Iqbal, KDA, and PECHS, when exploring your accommodation options. Availability of accommodation closer to campus will allow for a shorter and more convenient commute, making it easier for you to attend classes, participate in campus activities, and manage your daily schedule more comfortably. Disclaimer: We understand that safety and security are significant concerns when it comes to seeking accommodation. It is the student’s responsibility to visit the facilities in person and ensure that they meet your requirements, most importantly your privacy, safety, and security. In case of query or further information, please contact the representatives from the Office of Student Life at +92 21 34301051-55 (Ext. 4599).
